messages:
jane_sales: AlbionTech signed the NDA and asked for a short perf mini-bench next Wed 14:00 UTC. Scope: smoke, sustained, and a couple microbursts. Need: runbook for Ops, hosted vs Dedicated POC pricing, and a short KMS/audit blurb for their security team. Can someone lead? :wave:

omar_se: I can lead the run. Workload they shared: avg prompt ~380 tokens, gen ~120 tokens. Proposed plan: smoke 10m @ 15 qps, sustained 20m @ 70 qps, then 6 microbursts 25s @ 200 qps spaced 90s. Will provide a JMeter script + tiny python harness and a curl example.

liu_ops: Ops note: Dedicated pool recommended for stable p99 during bursts. Hosted ok if we pre-warm and allow burst autoscale (recommend capacity bump x2 for microbursts). Need their IP ranges, region preference, and whether they need 99.95 SLA. KMS/audit are enterprise add-ons; ops needs a named contact for key ownership.

deepak_eng: Can we test cold vs warm? Yes 1: include header X-RW-KV-Cache: false for cold; X-RW-Warm: true for warm. Curl snippet to give buyer:

```
POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-xl-1.0","input":"Summarize: <DOC_SNIPPET>","max_tokens":140}
```

omar_se: Harness will run both variants and tag metrics. We'll collect p50/p95/p99 and token-level counts.

jane_sales: Pricing ask from legal: assume ~120k gen tokens for the whole engagement + 2 days of follow-ups. Need hosted per-token BEO and Dedicated day-rate. Also include KMS/audit wording for security questionnaire (SOC2 mention).

liu_ops: Quick BEO: hosted gen ~ $0.0004/gen-token -> 120k ~= $48. Hosted support/ops for the run (monitoring + extra logs) ~= $125. Dedicated: small reserved 1-GPU day-rate ~= $475/day. Enterprise add-ons (KMS + audit log retention) ~= $500 setup + $200/mo. SOC2: provide certificate link and mention we can disable persistent token logs or enable redaction per contract.

deepak_eng: I'll be on-call during the run and watch Prometheus + rtail. Please enable 1% trace sampling and p50/p95/p99 windows for the window. If p99 > 2s during microbursts we scale extra nodes.

perf-bot: perf-harness v1.9 deployed to perf cluster by @perf-bot

jane_sales: I'll send AlbionTech the schedule, ask for IP ranges and KMS contact, and attach the quick pricing snapshot. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
